render.readiness: Wait for root completion and the committed about:srcdoc frame URL and completion before frame replacement.
assertions: Root history buffer aliases and resizable tracking/fixed views before and after reload
Frame document replacement URL, disconnected original root, and incremental write identity
Popup inherited base, message origin/source, history length and buffer aliases
Popup and opener identity survive root reload
Parent popup document.open retains history state and rewrites URL/base
Same-origin popup pushState and back restore serialized 8-byte state

limits: Not an official WPT harness run or a complete navigation qualification.
Cross-realm child-defined window functions and wider Navigation API behavior remain open.
Popup itself is asserted in script but not separately rendered.

The earlier combined proof's cross-document MutationObserver assertion was intermittent under repeated fresh sessions; this proof uses direct DOM replacement assertions, while the focused native/document tests cover observer behavior separately.
